# Contribution proposal

Thank you for offering work. Remove any section that does not apply, but keep
the privacy and rights checks.

## Contribution mode

- [ ] Volunteer correction: I knowingly offer this limited correction without
  payment.
- [ ] Paid terms required: do not merge until written payment terms are accepted.
- [ ] Discussion only: this proposes an idea and contributes no usable creative
  work.

## What changes

Describe the exact problem and the smallest proposed change.

## Source and rights

- [ ] I wrote or created this material, or I identified every source and have
  the right and consent to release it.
- [ ] Quotations preserve the exact speaker, wording, source, and visible cuts.
- [ ] AI assistance is identified and is not presented as evidence of consent or
  fact.

## Privacy and security

- [ ] This pull request contains no password, key, token, recovery phrase, bank
  detail, tax record, personal address, private conversation, private family or
  medical information, or unpublished defense mechanism.
- [ ] Payment and identity details will be exchanged only through an approved
  private process, never in GitHub content.

## Payment terms, when required

- [ ] ChuuPayMe proposed
- [ ] Stripe proposed
- [ ] Another route requires separate review

Link the public terms or state where the private written agreement is recorded.
Do not paste account credentials or regulated identity documents.

## Submission truth

- [ ] I understand that opening this pull request does not guarantee merge,
  publication, employment, or payment.
